root_cause.text: The function `rtw_core_enable_beacon()` used 32-bit read-modify-write operations (`rtw_write32_set`/`rtw_write32_clr`) on the register `REG_TXPAUSE`, whose address is not 4-byte aligned, causing an alignment fault on architectures that require aligned access.
root_cause.evidence: The crash trace shows an alignment fault at address `ffff8000827e0522` (not a multiple of 4) during `rtw_pci_read32` called from `rtw_core_enable_beacon`. The patch replaces the 32-bit accesses with 8-bit accesses (`rtw_write8_set`/`rtw_write8_clr`) to avoid unaligned memory access.
